events.note:
Hedwig Donna Lee (Zelmer) Bunger was born on October 28, 1931 to Edward and Bertha (Wall) Zelmer in rural Bridgewater, South Dakota. Donna Lee was called home on October 23, 2013, five days before her 82nd birthday at her home on the farm near Bridgewater, SD.

Donna Lee graduated from Bridgewater High School in 1950. On December 28, 1951 Donna Lee married Kenneth Bunger at the Zion Lutheran Church of Bridgewater, where she continued to be a member until her death. Donna Lee was a devoted wife, mother, grandmother and great grandmother. She worked for over 28 years at the Diamond Care Nursing Home where she cared for others as if they were her family. Donna Lee was active in church and was a member of both WELCA and Circle. On Sundays, you could find her either working at the nursing home or attending church. Donna Lee's greatest joy was being at home, spending time visiting with neighbors, and enjoying time with friends and family. She was a wonderful cook and loved to bake for not only her sons for also for any visitors that would stop by. Among her sons and families many favorites were her chocolate chip cookies, her chocolate chip pies, and her rhubarb and green tomato jelly.

Donna Lee is survived by sons Randall, Roger (Marcia) all of Spencer, Russell (Sherri) of Canistota, grandchildren Katie, Austin, Matt, Missy, Desiree, Cody and Taya; great grandson Ayden; sisters Minerva (Lester) Hanssen of Watertown, SD, Vivian Hanssen of Sioux Falls, SD, Daniel (Connie) Zelmer, sister-in-law LaVon Zelmer of Bridgewater, a special niece Joanie (Richard) Tarrell of Canistota, SD, and a host of friends and neighbors.

She was preceded in death by her parents, her husband Kenneth, her brother Harold Zelmer, her sister Erna Martens, and her infant brother Edward Jr.
